title: Shinonome Ena — Secondhand Ticket〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Phoenix Bridal Fair Venue

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, Hanasato, let's meet again in the audience when the show starts.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, what should we do until then?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The show doesn't start until the evening, so we have a bit of time on our hands now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are there any places that you haven't had a chance to visit yet, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Well, I've already seen all the exhibits...
So I guess that just leaves the interactive corner.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We haven't been there yet either.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? Then, wanna check it out together?

rows.Speaker: Honami & Shiho
rows.Line:
Yes!
Okay.
Interactive Corner

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wow... I sorta couldn't believe it when I saw the pamphlet, but they really do have a ton of different booths here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's see... That's the hairdressing area over there, and the area for making bouquets behind it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Making bouquets is supposed to be very fun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki and Mizuki made some together the last time we were here. They apparently chose flowers based on what they symbolize.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Based on what they symbolize, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I like how you can customize them based on that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Me too. Anyway, what else is there...?
Oh, you can make your own ring bearer boxes!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ring bearer boxes...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For the wedding rings and the pillow they sit on during the ceremony.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, they make whatever you put in them look really fancy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here, look. The description for this corner even says that they can double as accessory boxes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Accessory boxes...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It looks like they offer different case designs. We could make some really cute ones...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, you two sound pretty interested.
We have some free time, so wanna give it a go?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Have you two decided what your boxes are gonna look like?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I chose a glass case, so that I'll be able to see the pick I'm going to put inside.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, does this pick mean a lot to you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It does. This bassist I really look up to gave it to me a long time ago. I've had it in a small photo frame until now, but a clear box seemed like a nice alternative.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I see.
I'm going with a crown I can put regular accessories in.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I also really liked that one.
It was one of my final candidates.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I decided to go with the birdcage since I'm planning on putting a necklace in mine. I was worried that the chain would get tangled.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I see what you mean. It's really easy for a necklace to get all tangled if you don't hang it up somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, we're allowed to use all the decorations that are available to us here?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Looks like it. They even have sample pictures, so let's take a look around and see what our best options are.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This sounds like the hard part.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. So, let's get to work.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Most of your decorations are red and black, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I thought that I should try to match the colors of the pick I'm going to put in.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Not many flowers and stuff either.
I guess she's going with a simple design...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And she only took a quick glance at the sample pictures. Maybe she's come up with her own idea.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm seeing a lot of greens, pearls and lace with yours, Honami. That's gonna look so fancy once it's finished!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you.
One of the samples looked like it'd go with my necklace, so I'm using that as reference.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There's nothing wrong with that. Plus, you can customize it any way you like.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Hehe. Working diligently from the book. That's Honami, alright.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'd better get to work, too.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
This isn't really what I was going for...
Maybe I should use a thinner lace.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Maybe the lace for ribbons might...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, now it just feels like it's getting in the way. Lemme try taking it all off and leaving just the flowers. Then...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: All our ring bearer boxes turned out so well!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't wait to put my accessories in mine!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, sorry for making you two wait while I took some extra time to finish.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, that's okay. Watching you put your box together was actually kinda fun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You paid such close attention to the details. In particular, you seemed to spend quite a lot of time making sure you chose the right lace and flowers.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, thanks for noticing!
I couldn't help but try to make it so it looked good from all angles.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We also overheard her talking to herself...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But maybe we should leave that part out.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, what time is it?!
The show hasn't started yet, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We still have time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we may want to head over soon if we want to sit in a good spot.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Agreed. Then, let's head over to the stage area and meet back up with Minori.

rows.Speaker: Honami & Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay!
Okay.
